description_en: Transfers an active call to a destination phone number
kebab_example: aliyun ice forward-ai-agent-call --instance-id call_instance_202000000 --called-number 130000000000 --transfer-prompt Please_hold_while_I_transfer_your_call. --error-prompt 'We’re_sorry,_we’re_unable_to_transfer_your_call_at_the_moment._Please_try_again_later.' --caller-number 130000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ForwardAIAgentCall

parameters.help_en: The current call instance ID. This parameter is used only in inbound call transfer scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 当前通话实例ID,仅在呼入转接场景中使用
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The destination phone number to which the call is transferred
parameters.help_zh: 转接呼叫的目标电话号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.example: Please hold while I transfer your call.
parameters.help_en: The prompt text to play before the transfer begins. If this parameter is left empty, the prompt is skipped and the ringtone is played directly. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 转接开始前播放的提示语文本，为空则跳过提示直接播放铃声。默认空
parameters.name: transfer_prompt

parameters.example: We’re sorry, we’re unable to transfer your call at the moment. Please try again later.
parameters.help_en: The error prompt text to play when the transfer fails. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 转接失败时播放的异常提示文本。默认空
parameters.name: error_prompt

parameters.help_en:
The caller phone number for the transferred call. This parameter is optional.


<notice>
By default, CallerNumber is the phone number of the agent after the call is started: 1. For inbound lines, the agent number is the agent seat number. 2. For outbound lines, the agent number is the caller number.</notice>
<warning>Alibaba Cloud lines do not support this parameter.</warning>
parameters.help_zh:
转接呼叫的主叫电话。非必填。


<notice>
默认CallerNumber为启动电话后，智能体的电话号码:1. 呼入线路，智能体号码为坐席号码。2. 呼出线路，智能体号码为主叫号码。</notice>
<warning>阿里云线路不支持传入此参数。</warning>
parameters.name: caller_number
